title: The theatre of shadows
alt: A paper-art exhibition poster with a terracotta fox, layered miniature buildings and English lettering.
description: A fox-shaped paper city becomes an exhibition poster, including its title, subtitle and dates.
prompt: An extraordinary cultural exhibition poster made from layered cut paper. A giant graceful red-orange fox silhouette contains an intricate midnight city of tiny arches, staircases, trees, moonlit windows and teal rooftops; this is a deliberate graphic double-exposure composition, not anatomical realism. Cream paper edges, deep ultramarine shadows and one pale yellow moon give exceptional tactile depth. A strong typographic block occupies the bottom quarter with exactly four large readable lines. The only lettering reads: "THE THEATRE OF SHADOWS" "Small worlds. Extraordinary stories." "PAPER ART EXHIBITION" "14 NOVEMBER — 22 DECEMBER". Sophisticated museum-poster design, elegant restrained typography and precise spelling, no extra lettering.
